title: Savings
summary: Learn how saving differs from spending.

variants.markdown:
**English draft for R5 review.**

Saving means keeping some money for a future need. Gullak uses virtual money only. A savings balance is not a promise of future returns.

questions.prompt: What kind of money does Gullak use?
questions.explanation: Every Gullak portfolio uses virtual money.

options.text: To prepare for a future need

questions.explanation: Saving can help prepare for a future need; it cannot guarantee unlimited returns.
